verses.1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.2: "Speak to the Israelites and tell them, 'These are my offerings, the bread of my altar, the pleasing aroma I require of you. You must bring them to me at their appointed times.
verses.3: Say to them, This is the offering you must bring to the LORD: two unblemished year-old male lambs each day as a continual burnt offering.
verses.4: Present one lamb in the morning and the other lamb at twilight.
verses.5: And a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, a quarter of a hin of oil.
verses.6: This burnt offering, made at Mount Sinai, is a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.7: And its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for each lamb, poured out as a drink offering, a libation of joy to the LORD.
verses.8: And the second lamb you shall present at twilight, as for the morning offering and its drink offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.9: On the day of the Sabbath, you must bring two unblemished year-old male lambs, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil as a grain offering, and their drink offering.
verses.10: A Sabbath offering on the Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.11: And on the first days of your months, you must bring a burnt offering to the LORD: two unblemished bulls from the herd, one unblemished ram, and seven unblemished year-old male lambs.
verses.12: Their grain offering shall be three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for the ram.
verses.13: One tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb—a burnt offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD.
verses.14: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin for each bull, a third of a hin for the ram, and a quarter of a hin for each lamb. This is the monthly burnt offering, every month throughout the year.
verses.15: And one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, you must observe the Passover to the LORD.
verses.17: And on the fifteenth day of this month, you must hold a festival. For seven days you must eat unleavened bread.
verses.18: On the first day there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any laborious work.
verses.19: And you must bring a burnt offering to the LORD: two unblemished bulls from the herd, one unblemished ram, and seven unblemished year-old male lambs.
verses.20: And their grain offering shall be three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for the ram.
verses.21: One tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb, for the seven lambs.
verses.22: And one male goat for a sin offering, to atone for you.
verses.23: In addition to the morning burnt offering, which is the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.24: You must do this for seven days, each day bringing a grain offering, a pleasing aroma to the LORD, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.25: On the seventh day, there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any laborious work.
verses.26: And on the day of the first fruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD after your weeks are completed, there shall be a sacred assembly. You must not do any laborious work.
verses.27: And you must bring a burnt offering to the LORD, a pleasing aroma: two unblemished bulls from the herd, one unblemished ram, and seven unblemished year-old male lambs.
verses.28: Their grain offering shall be three tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for each bull, and two tenths of fine flour mixed with oil for the ram.
verses.29: One tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for each lamb, for the seven lambs.
verses.30: And one male goat for a sin offering, to atone for you.
verses.31: In addition to the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, they must be without blemish and their drink offerings must be poured out.

notes:
Notes
- v. 2: "pleasing aroma" is the standard translation of רֵיחַ נִיחֹחִי (re'ach niyho'khi), referring to a sacrifice accepted by God.
- v. 7: "libation of joy" is a contextual rendering of נֶסֶךְ שֵׁכָר (nesekh shekar), which literally means "wine libation."
- v. 14: "half a hin" is the standard rendering of חֲצִי הַהִין (khatzi ha-hin); the measure "hin" was a liquid unit in ancient Israel.
- v. 16-17: "Passover" and "festival" refer to the events described in Exodus 12 and Leviticus 23, respectively.
- v. 26: "day of the first fruits" refers to the Festival of Weeks (Shavuot), described in Leviticus 23:15-22.
